Both skills retain standalone starting inputs and complete outputs; no false mandatory PRD dependency.
IC-01 / D-xx connect real F-01 (C4) and F-02 (C5) evidence without inventing runtime observations.
No source edits, contract implementation, or automatic invocation.
Recommendation includes why, alternative and human decision needed.

Produces substantive conditional design in one pass.
No fake automatic routing or user approvals.
